correctness.rationale: The MGF follows exactly from the two conditional Erlang laws. The algebraic k-th root of -(1-p)/p gives an interior zero for each k>=2; two exact positive strip-distance formulas verify nonpole interior location. Analytic Lévy–Khintchine MGFs cannot vanish in their exponential-moment strip. For k=1 the exact log MGF equals an uncompensated finite-variation Lévy exponent with positive densities; strict inequalities on c ensure the subtracted exponential decays faster. value.rationale: A four-parameter natural signed waiting-time family switches completely between Lévy-increment embeddability and an analytic obstruction exactly at one Erlang stage. This structural classification is meaningful because infinite divisibility is not preserved under mixture; the result includes every integer common shape, both unequal rates, every interior sign weight, and the explicit positive boundary jump measure, without arbitrary slices or an unsupported downstream application.
